description: A part of a view: an `h2` `heading`, an optional `description`, `actions` for the whole section, and its content. `variant="card"` sets it on a bordered surface, for a settings group; `variant="divided"` rules it off from the section before, for a long form; `tone="danger"` marks destructive actions. Space sections with a Stack.
summary: A titled group of content with optional actions.
